title: foss-mcp authored examples sidecar
description: The structural contract of tests/fixtures/furnished/<pilot>/authored_examples.yaml (REQ-G3-007, TC-460): the single source of reviewed, worker-written example code for a pilot whose README cannot supply two verified examples. The runtime loader (src/foss_mcp/indexing/authored_examples.py) enforces the same structural rules in plain Python and adds the rules a schema cannot express: title uniqueness, the code hash, the pilot and commit being the expected ones, every symbol existing in the api_surface, the Authored example header comment and the forbidden-pattern scan. An authored example is published only after the ingestion verifier has verified it. TC-872 adds a second, additive entry kind, kind: upstream-sample (example code adapted from a file of the pilot's own upstream repository, with a mandatory source block), published under the same rule; a sidecar may hold up to 6 authored entries and up to 40 upstream samples.

schema_version.description: The format version. Always the integer 1.

pilot.description: The pilot directory name under tests/fixtures/furnished, for example imaging_net.

library_repository.description: The pinned library repository (owner/repo) the examples were written against.

library_commit.description: The pinned library commit (40 lowercase hex) the examples were written against.

language.description: The one language tag of the pilot's platform (csharp, cpp, python, java, go, rust, typescript or javascript).

examples.description: At most 6 authored entries plus at most 40 upstream-sample entries, at least 1 in total. An entry without kind is authored.

kind.description: Optional; an entry without kind is an authored entry.

title.description: The example's title; unique within the file (enforced by the loader).

description.description: Non-empty plain text shown before the code.

symbols.description: The API symbols (qualified names from the pilot's api_surface) the example exercises.

code.description: The example program. Its first non-blank line is a comment containing the words Authored example.

code_sha256.description: sha256 of the code after the whitespace normalisation of example_candidates.normalised_code_sha256.

kind.description: Marks an example adapted from a file of the pilot's own upstream repository (TC-872).

title.description: The example's title; unique within the file (enforced by the loader).

description.description: Non-empty plain text shown before the code.

symbols.description: The API symbols (qualified names from the pilot's api_surface) the example exercises.

code.description: The adapted upstream program. No header comment is required.

code_sha256.description: sha256 of the code after the whitespace normalisation of example_candidates.normalised_code_sha256.

upstreamSource.description: Where an upstream sample came from. The loader also requires commit to equal the sidecar's library_commit, which a schema cannot express.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the upstream file: no leading slash or drive letter, no backslash, no '..' segment.

commit.description: The upstream commit the file was read at (40 lowercase hex); equal to library_commit.

adaptation.description: One sentence: what was changed to make the file a standalone example.
